[SWS_DM_00955] Configuration of DTC "aging counter up/down" as extended data record
⌈
If the configuration parameter DiagnosticPro-
videdDataMapping.dataProvider of the corresponding DiagnosticParame-
ter.dataElement is set to DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT or to DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT,
the DM shall report the internal value of the current aging counter of the contextual DTC
in the respective DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord’s DiagnosticDataElement
based on [SWS_DM_00956] or [SWS_DM_00957].
⌋

[SWS_DM_00955] Configuration of DTC "aging counter up/down" as extended data record
⌈
If the DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement is referred by DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement and DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.dataProvider is set to DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT or
to DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT, the DM shall report the internal value of the cur-
rent aging counter of the contextual DTC in the respective DiagnosticEx-
tendedDataRecord’s DiagnosticDataElement based on [SWS_DM_00956] or
[SWS_DM_00957].
The length of this internal data element is one byte.
